Product Details: IBELL VORMIR 800W Rotary Hammer Drill VR RH 26-24, 3J Impact Energy Heavy Duty SDS Plus Hammer Drill, 26mm Concrete Drilling,0-900 RPM, 4000 BPM, Copper Armature, 3 Mode Operation,1 Year Warranty - Distributed/Packaged by Ibell Tools. Product Details: [SPECIFICATIONS] Rated voltage: 220V~50Hz, Rated Input Power: 800W(26-24) 780W(26-26)., Rated no load speed: 0-900 rpm, Impact rate at nominal speed: 4000/min, Impact energy per stroke: 3 J, Chuck SDS Plus capacity: 26 mm, Drilling capacity :Wood-30 mm, Steel-13 mm, Concrete-26 mm, Masonry-68 mm, Protection class : Class Il [GENERAL PURPOSE] The VR RH26-24 Rotary hammer can perform heavy-duty tasks such as drilling and chiselling hard materials. This uses a piston mechanism which deliver a much more powerful hammer blow, making it possible to drill bigger holes much faster. [THREE MODE OPERATION] Operation mode can be adjusted by a knob to 1) Rotary drilling: for screw-driving and for drilling into steel, wood and plastics; 2) Hammer-drilling: for concrete and masonry drilling operations & 3) Hammering only: for light chipping, chiselling and demolition applications. In this mode the tool can also be used as a lever to free a jammed drill bit. [WORK CAPACITY] The hammer has an SDS Plus chuck with 26 mm capacity and the maximum drilling capacity for concrete is 26mm, wood is 30mm, steel is 13mm. [ADDITIONAL CHUCK] To drill a wood or metal material, the additional 13 mm Hammer Drill chuck can be used. [OTHER ACCESSORIES] The Auxiliary handle can be fitted to suit both right-handed and left-handed users which can be rotated 360°. The depth rod can be used to set a constant depth to drill. Suitable bits are also available with the product. 6 months standard warranty + 6 Months additional warranty on registration ( Registration should be done within 30 days from the date of Purchase)
